description: Checkpoint for the Daily Code Review routine. Records the last commit on the default branch (main) that has been reviewed. The next run diffs main from this SHA forward. Update after each run.

lastRun.notes:
9 commits / 23 files (~893 insertions, ~64 deletions). One ticket filed: ADS-1424 (Improvement, Medium) — ADS-1408's chat sender/participant-name fix enriched only the REST path (ListChats/GetChat/SearchChats/GetMessages); the real-time WebSocket fan-out (chat-subscriber.ts chat:message:created) still carries no senderName, so a message pushed live into an open conversation renders nameless (and the aria-label degrades to 'Message from : …') until a REST refetch heals it. ADS-1408 is now closed Done, so the gap would not resurface without a new ticket. Overlap check (guardrail 3): searched Linear across ALL labels for chat/sender/websocket/realtime; only ADS-1408 (Done, REST-only) is adjacent, nothing tracks the WS path.

The 9 commits:
- 4591685 (#1540) fix(gateway): align jspdf/jspdf-autotable specs with app.admin (ADS-1413) — deps caret-range alignment; clean, maps to ADS-1413 (DevEx/deps). No code-review finding.
- 3288c46 (#1539) docs(backend): correct error-forwarding rule + schema table lists — docs only.
- 18713d8 (#1538) fix(tooling): include .cjs/.js in root format:check glob (ADS-1411) — tooling/CI; maps to ADS-1411 (DevEx).
- e1c4434 (#1536) feat(chat): enrich search results with sender/participant names (ADS-1408) — REVIEWED IN DEPTH (part of the ADS-1408 REST enrichment). SearchChats hits enriched via the same deduped lookupNames fan-out; consistent, tested. Contributes to ADS-1424.
- 35e37de (#1535) feat(chat): resolve real participant/sender names for chat list/get/messages (ADS-1408) — REVIEWED IN DEPTH. Implements ADS-1408's preferred solution (1): new auth GetUserName RPC (unscoped, principal-only, first/last name only, no PII/email), gateway lookupNames mirrors applications.ts lookupById EXACTLY (deduped Promise.all per-id, tolerate failures, skip when authClient absent — repo convention, 'no batch RPC'; N+1 concern NOT a finding per architectural alignment). getUserName reachable ONLY from chat.ts enrichment with service-response ids, never caller-supplied → no IDOR. Handler/route/adapter all tested (+80/+169/+50 lines). The ONE gap cleared the bar: WS path not enriched → ADS-1424.
- 0b8cadb (#1537) fix(ci): fall back across Trivy DB mirrors when one rate-limits — ci only (DevEx).
- e799b01 (#1534) docs(secrets): recommend hex for connection-URL-embedded passwords (ADS-1409) — docs only.
- 03b703e (#1533) chore(review): record daily-code-review checkpoint at f629772 (ADS-1408) — our own prior checkpoint commit; skipped.
- 09c0e02 (#1532) fix(gateway): reject undefined file-type sniff for document MIMEs (ADS-1405) — REVIEWED by hand. Rejects document-container MIMEs (pdf/doc/docx) that sniff undefined (bytes smuggled behind a document Content-Type), keeps pass-through for other unclassifiable types; well-reasoned, tested (+54). Security routine territory, maps to ADS-1405. No introduced regression.

Method: the two chat feature commits (35e37de, e1c4434) are one logical change — the ADS-1408 REST enrichment — and got a dedicated deep review against correctness/edge-cases/SQL/type-safety/authz/test-coverage. The upload-content-checks and jspdf hardening/deps commits map to existing Security/DevEx tickets (ADS-1405, ADS-1413); reviewed the product-code changes by hand for introduced regressions — none. docs/ci/tooling commits are DevEx/Security routine territory (guardrails 3 & 5). Guardrail 2 respected: no manufactured Low-priority tickets; only the one WS-gap finding cleared the bar.
